contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [CON]STANTIN[--]IVN[--] ; R/ GLOR IA EXERC ITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, probably of Constantine II (317-340), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [CON]STANTIN[--]IVN[--]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them; both standards bear a ring and dot device on the vexillum. Reverse inscription: GLOR IA EXERC ITVS. Diameter: 17.2mm, Weight: 1.86gms, die axis: 6
